hooks.command: in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/require_description.py || printf '%s' "$in" | python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/require_description.py || (echo 'description-hook is broken, probably because Python is not installed. If this keeps happening, disable the plugin with /plugin.' >&2; exit 1)

if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/require_description.py" } else { & python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/require_description.py" }; if (-not $?) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('description-hook is broken, probably because Python is not installed. If this keeps happening, disable the plugin with /plugin.'); exit 1 }
